FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Vacuum Ventures Sales & Service specializes in retail sales and servicing of vacuum cleaners. Our operations include offering a range of new and refurbished vacuum cleaners from reputable manufacturers, ensuring all products meet current safety standards. We also provide professional in-shop repairs, maintenance, and servicing for residential and small commercial vacuum cleaners, performed by certified technicians following documented safety protocols. To enhance customer satisfaction, we also sell accessories, filters, and replacement parts. Our staff is well-trained in safety and technical aspects of repair work, strictly adhering to local regulations for electrical safety and environmental disposals. Each of our operations is supervised to mitigate risks and uphold high service standards, maintaining strong vendor relationships to ensure quality throughout our offerings.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss occurred on 03/05/2023 due to electrical malfunction leading to a minor fire incident in the service area, resulting in a claim amount of $1,200.00. Status: Repaired and compliant with safety protocols.
